column1: # A coding workspace names one repository the coding lane may operate on:
# the mirror the service imports approved base revisions into, and the
# ephemeral worktrees a job edits. repository_path is the authoritative
# checkout the import bundle is read from; mirror names the bare repository
# under the qwen-coder principal's repos root; test_profile names the one
# command set code.run_tests may execute inside the worktree, resolved in
# scripts/coding-profiles.tsv rather than taken from a request.
